chunks: Abu Yasir Tahir, the غلام (servant/page) of Abu al-Jaysh.

key_terms.أَبُو: A kunya element meaning 'father of,' used as part of a personal designation.
key_terms.أَبِي: The genitive form of Abu, part of the name Abu al-Jaysh.
key_terms.الْجَيْشِ: Literally 'the army'; here part of the proper name Abu al-Jaysh.
key_terms.غُلَامُ: A servant, page, or attendant; here indicating affiliation or service.
key_terms.يَاسِرٍ: The second part of the kunya, identifying the person as Abu Yasir.

ai.seo_question: Who is Abu Yasir Tahir in Tahdhib al-Ahkam?
ai.summary: This brief entry identifies a person by name and affiliation: Abu Yasir Tahir, who is described as the غلام of Abu al-Jaysh. It functions as a biographical notice within a scholarly listing of shaykhs or associated figures.
